texts.text:
RECUP rescues surplus food from markets
and shares it freely with anyone, bringing

texts.label: La collaborazione
texts.text:
Thanks to our collaboration, rescued food
became part of our SFT Day buffet.

texts.label: Sottotitolo
texts.text: The boat, the project and the people behind it.

caption:
What a day! ❤️ Thank you to everyone who joined SFT Day and to everyone who helped make it happen. We loved sharing our project, our boat and a day together with you.

A special thank-you to RECUP, a wonderful community we loved collaborating with. Their volunteers rescue surplus food from markets and share it freely with anyone. Through food rescue and participation, they fight waste and bring people together.

Together, we recovered food from local markets that would otherwise have been thrown away and used it to prepare part of our buffet. Sharing that food made the day even more special.

Here are a few of our favourite moments. See you next time!
